text_to_speech: I love skateboarding and I always have I started skateboarding probably when I was three years old by 1976 I was already riding some little balls and stuff in the middle school friend made a longboard skateboard for me in woodshop and it really felt like surfing so I always liked my longboard and just riding on Hill just felt real surfy so guess what motivates me to skateboard as much as I can the feeling I get when I'm on a skateboard is just really right it feels good when I'm on a skateboard it's really comfortable I feel more comfortable in my skateboard than probably anything just being with friends outsides healthy productive longboarding has been something to me that connects me to surfing when the waves aren't good or whatever surfing can be a really arduous process waiting for waves and you know working and driving and stuff whereas skateboarding you can do almost any day wherever you want it's it's there for me every day skateboarding to never left me and I hope I never leave it my name's Brad Edwards I love to skateboard you
